name: Card
summary: A bounded surface with a hairline border and optional subtle shadow. v0.12.1 introduced the corner-clip contract — padding='none' auto-clips edge-touching children to the rounded shape. v0.12.4 closed the trade-off the corner-clip introduced for descendant focus rings: the global :focus-visible rule now pairs outline 2px solid lime-a64 + offset 1px (structurally immune to ancestor overflow:hidden) with the existing soft box-shadow halo, so focus rings on Pagination buttons and other interactive descendants inside <Card padding='none'> stay visible. The v0.12.4 Combobox portal migration also means a hand-rolled Combobox dropdown inside <Card padding='none'> now escapes the clip exactly like Radix-portaled chrome already did.

padding.description: Inline + block padding tier. 'none' = body controls its own padding (table, full-bleed media); xs/sm/md/lg/xl = p-2/p-3/p-4/p-6/p-8; hero = p-10 md:p-12. v0.12.1 — 'none' composes overflow-hidden so edge-touching children clip to the rounded shape; other tiers do not (their p-N insets float children off the curved edge entirely).

elevation.description: Shadow + border combination. 'flat' = no shadow + hairline; 'card' = shadow.sm + hairline (default); 'lifted' = shadow.md + hairline (interactive cards on hover); 'popover' = shadow.popover + subtle border; 'glass' = lumen-glass translucent + transparent border; 'glow' = shadow.glow.accent.strong + accent border (hero, lit-edge moments).

interactive.description: Adds hover state and focus-visible. Pair with as='button' or as='a' to render the correct semantic element.

selected.description: Adds 1 px accent border + accent-tint bg. For listbox-style cards, announces via aria-selected.

as.description: Render-as polymorphism. Interactive cards must use 'button' (action) or 'a' (navigation), never 'div' with onClick.

tokens._note: padding='none' is padding: 0 (not modelled as a DTCG token — it's an empty value). The six elevation tiers (flat/card/lifted/popover/glass/glow) compose existing semantic shadow tokens via the runtime ELEV record; there are no card-specific shadow.{flat,lifted,popover,glow} aliases. elevation='glass' uses the .lumen-glass runtime class; elevation='glow' uses the runtime --shadow-glow-accent-strong CSS variable (which is a multi-layer composition declared in globals.css, not a single DTCG token — see ADR 0018). Neither needs a DTCG-tier alias because Card's elevation prop is a CSS-class composition layer, not a token-mapping layer.

rules: Non-interactive cards do NOT receive a role.
Interactive cards render as <button> (action) or <a> (navigation). Never <div onClick>.
Selection announces via aria-pressed (button) or aria-selected (listbox).

The v0.12.1 corner-clip contract does not affect a11y. v0.12.4 closed the trade-off where overflow:hidden partially clipped descendant box-shadow focus rings — the global :focus-visible rule now pairs outline 2px solid lime-a64 + offset 1px (structurally immune to ancestor overflow) with the existing soft box-shadow halo. Focus rings on Pagination buttons, inline links, and any other interactive descendants inside <Card padding='none'> stay visible. The .lumen-btn-primary:focus-visible dual-ring is unaffected — declares outline:none and wins via specificity per ADR 0016.

do: Default to hairline border only, no shadow (elevation='card', the default).
Pair with CardHeader when the card has a title.
Use padding='none' when the body controls its own padding (table inside a card, full-bleed media). The primitive auto-clips edge-touching children to the rounded shape.
Use elevation='lifted' on hover for interactive cards; transition with motion.transition.fast.
Use elevation='glow' for the rare hero-tier card that should announce itself with the spring-green halo.
dont: Don't stack shadows. One per card.
Don't nest cards more than one level deep.
Don't use a heavy border for emphasis. Use selected or a status badge instead.
Don't manually add className='overflow-hidden' on a <Card padding='none'> — the primitive already composes it (v0.12.1).
Don't add overflow-hidden to other padding tiers expecting the same behaviour — those tiers don't need it and may inadvertently suppress focus rings or hover halos.

changelog.note: Initial release. Four padding tiers (none/sm/md/lg), single shadow elevation, interactive + selected states, polymorphic 'as' prop.

Alignment contract. Outer Card owns inline padding via p-N; slot content (CardHeader/CardContent/CardFooter) zeroes its own px-6 via the SLOT_PX_ZERO triple. Pre-v0.10.1 the slot specificity beat the wrapper's px-0 → 24-px misalignment between slot content and bare-text siblings.

Padding tiers extended to seven (added xs, xl, hero). Elevation prop introduced with six values (flat/card/lifted/popover/glass/glow); pre-v0.11 single-shadow assumption replaced by a six-tier ladder so cards can express the full v0.11 elevation language without consumer-side className overrides.

Corner-clip contract — padding='none' now composes overflow-hidden so edge-touching children (table headers, pagination footers, full-bleed media) auto-clip to the rounded shape. Other padding tiers do not compose overflow-hidden because their p-N insets already float children off the curved edge. Radix-portaled popovers/dropdowns/tooltips render outside the Card subtree and are unaffected. User screenshot 2026-05-06 of /saas Pagination 'Next' button caught the artifact (square nub of pagination footer poked past the rounded card corner). See ADR 0021. Cascade benefits: /saas Shipments card top-right + bottom-right corners clean, /foundations Satoshi typeface card clean, /commerce related-product cards lose their hand-added className='overflow-hidden' workaround.

Corner-clip contract is now strictly net-positive for the system. The two trade-offs v0.12.1 left open both close in v0.12.4: (a) hand-rolled non-Radix popovers (Combobox dropdown) inside <Card padding='none'> were clipped by the overflow:hidden — fixed by migrating Combobox to createPortal(<div fixed>, document.body) with getBoundingClientRect tracking, so the dropdown escapes the card subtree exactly like Radix-portaled chrome already does; (b) box-shadow-based focus rings on interactive descendants (Pagination buttons) inside <Card padding='none'> were partially clipped — fixed by adding outline 2px solid var(--lumen-lime-a64); outline-offset: 1px; to the global :focus-visible rule on top of the existing soft box-shadow halo. Outline paints outside the layout box and is structurally immune to ancestor overflow. The .lumen-btn-primary:focus-visible dual-ring is unaffected (declares outline:none and wins via specificity per ADR 0016). Sibling pattern at smaller-control scale: the InlineTabs pill variant TabsList composes overflow-hidden for the same reason — the active tab's smaller-radius corners would otherwise poke past the parent's larger-radius curve. The contract generalizes: any rounded container hosting children with their own backgrounds and smaller-radius corners needs overflow-hidden on the parent. No new ADR — these are consequential follow-ups to ADR 0021. See CHANGELOG v0.12.4 entry.
